name: Pokémon Crystal Awakening
summary: Pokémon Crystal Awakening is a ROM hack and visual overhaul project built on the Pokémon Crystal disassembly. It reimagines the game’s world with a complete tileset redesign inspired by Game Boy Color era Zelda titles, especially Link’s Awakening, while also drawing visual ideas from the Oracle games. The project keeps the core structure of a classic Pokémon RPG but gives each area a distinct new look, blending familiar exploration and adventure gameplay with a retro fantasy presentation.
